name: pdist
expr: d_e = pdist(X); d_c = pdist(X, 'cityblock'); d_m = pdist(X, 'minkowski', 3); d_cos = pdist(X, 'cosine'); d_mh = pdist(X, 'mahalanobis'); d_mhI = pdist(X, 'mahalanobis', C);
comment: Sig: D = pdist(X[, metric[, p|C]]). Pairwise distances. Coverage: euclidean, cityblock, minkowski(p=3), cosine, mahalanobis(default cov(X)), mahalanobis with explicit C. Bug fix 2026-05-08: mahalanobis was throwing 'unknown metric'. Function-handle metric still not supported (separate gap).
